soilgrids_cec.description: SoilGrids 2.0 — Cation Exchange Capacity, 0-5 cm topsoil, mean. Direct proxy for nutrient availability and forest soil fertility.
soilgrids_cec.citation: Poggio et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7:217-240.

field_qfield.description: Field inventory collected on QField (placettes + arbres layers), produced by create_qfield_project() and re-ingested via import_qfield_gpkg().

chm_opencanopy.description: Canopy Height Model from opencanopy (IGN BD ORTHO + Open-Canopy pretrained models)

provenance.base_data: BD ORTHO IGN + Open-Canopy pretrained weights (Fogel et al. 2024)

license.open_canopy: MIT (code) / CC-BY-4.0 (data) — to confirm at commit

forms_t.description: FORMS-T — Forest Multiple-Source height, wood volume and biomass time-series over metropolitan France (2018-present). Deep-learning fusion of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and GEDI spaceborne lidar. Three products: canopy height (10 m), standing wood volume (30 m), aboveground biomass (30 m).

access.note: Distributed by DATA TERRA / THEIA (CDS-MTD diffusion service). COG assets are resolved per-tile and per-year from the STAC catalog, or downloaded as .tif from the Zenodo record. There is no single static URL, so load_raster_source() cannot fetch this source directly: the caller must resolve the STAC asset href (or a local download path) first.

height.note: FORMS-T height is stored in centimetres (10^-2 m). The nemeton indicator `chm` argument expects metres: divide the raster by 100 before passing it to indicateur_p1_volume(), indicateur_p2_station(), indicateur_c1_biomasse() or indicateur_b2_structure().

consumed_by.C1: indicateur_c1_biomasse(chm = forms_t_height / 100) — canopy height feeds the CHM biomass path V(D, H) x rho x BEF x C_frac.
consumed_by.P1: indicateur_p1_volume(chm = forms_t_height / 100) — dominant height for the IFN volume tarif.
consumed_by.P2: indicateur_p2_station(chm = forms_t_height / 100) — H_dom for the Duplat & Tran-Ha site index.

provenance.method: Deep-learning multi-stream model fusing Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and GEDI lidar; biomass and volume via allometric equations fitted on French NFI plots.
provenance.reference: Schwartz et al. (2023) FORMS: Forest Multiple Source height, wood volume, and biomass maps in France at 10 to 30 m resolution. Earth Syst. Sci. Data 15:4927-4945. doi:10.5194/essd-15-4927-2023

forms_t.license: CC-BY-4.0 (to confirm at the Zenodo record before redistribution)

s2_biophysical.description: Sentinel-2 biophysical variables (Theia): Leaf Area Index (LAI), Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation (FAPAR) and Fractional Vegetation Cover (FVC), retrieved at decametric resolution from Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance.

access.note: Theia value-added product distributed per Sentinel-2 tile. There is no single static URL, so load_raster_source() cannot fetch this source directly: the caller resolves the catalogue/STAC asset href (or a local download path) first.
access.stac_collection: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

consumed_by.C2: vitality signal complementing NDVI: FAPAR and LAI track canopy photosynthetic activity.
consumed_by.A1: tree canopy cover derived from FVC (fractional vegetation cover).
consumed_by.B2: structural heterogeneity via the per-unit coefficient of variation of LAI.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA value-added product chain
provenance.method: Neural-network inversion of a radiative-transfer model on Sentinel-2 L2A reflectance (SNAP biophysical processor lineage).
provenance.reference: Weiss & Baret (2016) S2ToolBox Level-2 products: LAI, FAPAR, FVC; Bochenek et al. / Theia documentation.

s2_biophysical.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

theia_soil.description: Theia soil maps for metropolitan France: topsoil particle-size fractions (clay, silt, sand) and coarse-element content, mapped by combining satellite imagery with soil-sample databases.
theia_soil.resolution_m: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

access.note: Theia 'Soil' theme product (metropolitan France). No single static URL: the caller resolves the catalogue download path first.

consumed_by.F1: soil texture as a direct fertility proxy — a France-wide alternative to the global SoilGrids CEC layer (soilgrids_cec).
consumed_by.F2: soil erodibility derived from the silt/sand/clay balance.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — Soil scientific expertise centre
provenance.method: Digital soil mapping from multi-temporal satellite imagery and soil-profile databases.

theia_soil.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

theia_snow.description: Theia Snow collection (Let-it-snow / LIS): high-resolution snow-cover maps from Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8, plus annual snow-cover phenology syntheses (snow-cover duration, onset and melt-out dates).

access.reference: Gascoin et al. (2019) Theia Snow collection: high-resolution operational snow cover maps. Earth Syst. Sci. Data 11:493-514. doi:10.5194/essd-11-493-2019

consumed_by.R3: snowpack as a seasonal soil-water reserve that modulates summer drought stress, especially in mountain massifs.
consumed_by.W: winter water-input proxy for the water-regulation family.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — CESBIO (Let-it-snow processing chain)
provenance.method: Normalized Difference Snow Index thresholding constrained by a digital elevation model.

theia_snow.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

theia_water.description: Theia surface-water product (Surfwater lineage): open-water extent masks and water-occurrence frequency derived from Sentinel-2 (and Sentinel-1) time series.

access.note: Theia 'Continental waters' theme product. No single static URL: the caller resolves the catalogue/STAC asset href first.
access.stac_collection: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

consumed_by.W1: satellite-observed hydrographic network, complementing the BD TOPO water layer.
consumed_by.W2: wetland detection via seasonal water-occurrence frequency.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — Continental waters scientific expertise centre
provenance.method: Multi-temporal classification of Sentinel-2/Sentinel-1 surface reflectance and backscatter.

theia_water.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

theia_soil_moisture.description: Theia soil-moisture products: a coarse SMOS L3 surface soil-moisture map (regional context only) and, where available, a finer Sentinel-1-derived surface soil-moisture map.

access.note: The SMOS L3 variant (~25-43 km) is far too coarse for parcel-level analysis: use it only as regional drought context. The Sentinel-1-derived variant, when available, is the one usable per unit.

consumed_by.W3: observed surface soil moisture, complementing the topographic wetness index (TWI).
consumed_by.R3: soil-water deficit signal feeding the drought-risk indicator.
consumed_by.F1: moisture regime as a secondary fertility modifier.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — CATDS (SMOS) and Sentinel-1 soil-moisture chains
provenance.method: Microwave radiometry (SMOS) and radar backscatter inversion (Sentinel-1).

theia_soil_moisture.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

s2_l2a_muscate.description: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance (Theia MUSCATE production): ortho-rectified, atmospherically corrected reflectance with cloud, cloud-shadow, water and snow masks. A French national alternative to the CDSE / Planetary Computer Sentinel-2 feed already ingested by nemeton.

access.note: MUSCATE Sentinel-2 L2A is distributed per tile and per date. No single static URL: the caller resolves the catalogue download path first.
access.stac_collection: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

consumed_by.C2: NDVI / vitality computation from corrected surface reflectance.
consumed_by.T2: change detection on multi-date reflectance composites.
consumed_by.R5: alternative Sentinel-2 input for the rolling-window and FORDEAD health pipelines.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — MUSCATE production centre (CNES)
provenance.method: MAJA atmospheric correction and cloud screening on Sentinel-2 Level-1C.

s2_l2a_muscate.license: Etalab Open Licence 2.0 (to confirm at the Theia catalogue record)

theia_species.description: Theia tree-species classification: dominant forest-species maps derived from Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 time series. Provides a species input layer for indicators that otherwise rely on a user-supplied species column.

access.note: Theia 'Land cover / Biodiversity' theme product. No single static URL: the caller resolves the catalogue/STAC asset href first.
access.stac_collection: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

dominant_species.note: Class-to-species mapping is product-specific and must be aligned with nemeton species codes (see R/species-config.R) before use.

consumed_by.B1: species-composition input for the protection indicator.
consumed_by.B2: species diversity component of the structure indicator.
consumed_by.P: species input for the productive family (P1 volume, P2 site index, P3 quality) when no field species column is present.
consumed_by.C: species input for the carbon family (C1 biomass allometry).

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — Land cover scientific expertise centre
provenance.method: Supervised classification of Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 time series.

theia_species.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

theia_lst.description: Theia land-surface-temperature product (Thermocity lineage): satellite-derived land-surface temperature, usable as a microclimate / heat-stress proxy.

access.note: Thermocity is urban-oriented; spatial coverage and resolution are to be confirmed against the analysis area of interest.

land_surface_temperature.resolution_m: to confirm at the Theia catalogue

consumed_by.A2: land-surface temperature as a microclimate and heat-stress proxy for the air-quality / microclimate indicator.

provenance.producer: Theia / DATA TERRA — Thermocity processing chain
provenance.method: Thermal-infrared satellite retrieval of land-surface temperature.

theia_lst.license: to confirm at the Theia catalogue record

formspot.description: FORMSpoT — tree-level, country-scale forest monitoring over roughly a decade, from the FORMS product family. Individual-tree detection and attributes (height/biomass lineage), finer than the FORMS-T 10-30 m grids.

access.note: Published as the THEIA STAC collection FORMSpoT (browser.datastore-mtd.theia.data-terra.org/collections/FORMSpoT). Distributed per tile/year via STAC, so load_raster_source() cannot fetch it directly: resolve the STAC asset href (or a local download path) first.

height.unit: to confirm (m or cm — check the FORMSpoT collection metadata)
height.note: Consumed as a high-resolution Canopy Height Model through the `chm` argument of the C1/P1/P2/B2 indicators. Convert to metres first if the collection delivers heights in centimetres.

consumed_by.C1: indicateur_c1_biomasse(chm = ...) — tree-level canopy height fed as a high-resolution CHM.
consumed_by.P1: indicateur_p1_volume(chm = ...) — dominant height for the IFN volume tarif.
consumed_by.P2: indicateur_p2_station(chm = ...) — H_dom for the Duplat & Tran-Ha site index.

formspot.integration_note: FORMSpoT integrates through the existing `chm` argument of C1/P1/P2/B2 — the same Canopy Height Model interface already used by FORMS-T (forms_t) and chm_opencanopy. No dedicated indicator argument is required: load the height product via load_raster_source('formspot', path = ...) and pass it as `chm`. If FORMSpoT is distributed as a vector tree-point layer rather than a height raster, rasterise the tree-height attribute first.

provenance.producer: FORMS product family (Schwartz et al. lineage)
provenance.method: Deep-learning tree-level monitoring from multi-source satellite imagery.
provenance.reference: FORMSpoT: A Decade of Tree-Level, Country-Scale Forest Monitoring. arXiv:2512.17021.

formspot.license: to confirm at the THEIA collection record
